title: Study links late-night meals to up to 30% higher liver disease risk

A comprehensive study involving nearly 200,000 participants over a median span of 16 years found that those who dined late displayed increased cases of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and cirrhosis. The underlying mechanisms linking meal timing to liver health are still not well understood, warranting further exploration into how eating habits impact liver well-being.

Iyer emphasized the importance of maintaining their aggressive approach while addressing fielding improvements. New Zealand also made a change, bringing in Jacob Duffy for Adam Milne.

description: Australian umpire Ben Treloar is experiencing Indian domestic cricket for the first time as part of the BCCI-Cricket Australia exchange programme. From aeroplanes flying overhead at Delhi's Palam ground to Mumbai's red-soil pitch at BKC, the 44-year-old shares his impressions of Indian first-class cricket, the warmth of its people and his growing love for local cuisine, including garlic naan and vada pav.

title: ‘838’ number plate, pool of blood, screams: Chilling video captures daylight murder
description: In a shocking act of violence in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, bystanders witnessed a murder as Devesh Dixit was pursued and collided with a vehicle. His friend-turned-assailant, Pawan Parashar, went on to deliver a fatal blow using a stick and iron rod. The police arrived shortly after, and Parashar voluntarily surrendered later at the station. Investigations continue to reveal the motive behind this brutal attack.

title: 'Four years, I never chased this jersey': Bhuvneshwar Kumar on India comeback
description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar credited patience, preparation and a no-expectations mindset for helping him return to international cricket after four years. The 36-year-old said the IPL and domestic cricket kept him sharp while improving his maturity. He also discussed modern T20 challenges, stressing that bowlers need smart strategies. India's strong start against New Zealand, he added, could boost confidence throughout the tour.

From fuel price hikes to cost-of-living concerns, US consumer sentiment nears record low
description: US consumer sentiment has declined slightly as rising prices related to the Middle East conflict affect households' financial views. The Consumer Sentiment Index fell marginally to 48.0 in October, approaching a record low. Independents reported significantly weaker sentiment while Democrats and Republicans showed improvements. Inflation expectations rose, suggesting concerns about future price increases among consumers. The Federal Reserve is expected to maintain current interest rates during their upcoming meeting.

title: India script history with best-ever finish and record 114 medals at Asian Para Games
description: India concluded the Asian Para Games 2026 with an extraordinary display of talent, amassing a total of 114 medals, consisting of 30 gold, 35 silver, and 49 bronze. This achievement surpasses their previous record from 2022 edition, securing a commendable fourth place overall. The rise of India's para-athletes on the continental stage was evident, even as China led with an impressive 217 gold medals.

title: Did Van Gogh’s ‘Starry Night’ depict real sky from July 1889? Scientists think so
description: In a groundbreaking study, South Korean researchers have pinpointed July 22, 1889, as a possible date for the celestial scene depicted in The Starry Night. This new timeline disputes the widely accepted June 1889 date. The study notes that the alignment of stars aligns with observations from that evening, bolstered by van Gogh's letters that reference weather conditions, suggesting the artist's keen attention to his surroundings.

Authorities are increasing police presence, with around 70,000 officers deployed this weekend across France. Demonstrations are planned in several cities, amidst ongoing political tensions leading to protests against rising living costs. While some support the protests, others condemn the associated looting and vandalism.

The English Chess Federation praised her as a “generational talent.” Already the youngest Woman Grandmaster qualifier, Bodhana has achieved several historic milestones and is now aiming to become a Grandmaster, chess’s highest title.

Pollard expressed his gratitude for the opportunity and emphasised his connection to the team. The franchise is hopeful that Pollard will help restore their winning form. Mumbai Indians aims to build on their past successes and inspire their fans.

Allegations state that the contractor set up equipment before the bids were officially opened. Delhi Jal Board representatives clarify that they have conducted defoaming campaigns annually since 2022.

The accused was reportedly under the influence of alcohol when he attacked the doctor. Medical officers in Wardha district protested by boycotting work, highlighting safety concerns for healthcare personnel. Subsequently, police registered a case against the accused based on the medical officer's complaint.

Using traditional means of noise-making, they called for urgent government intervention. Key demands included the establishment of the National Register of Citizens and an improved response to ethnic tensions, showcasing a strong public insistence for accountability and resolution.

title: Husband’s illicit relationship by itself is not cruelty: Madras high court
description: Madras high court ruled that a husband's illicit relationship is not sufficient for cruelty under Section 498A. This ruling came from a case involving a woman who committed suicide with her child. The court noted that more evidence is required to establish cruelty beyond mere allegations of an affair. The trial court had acquitted the husband due to insufficient evidence linking him to dowry harassment.
